body_ar: التوبة واجبة على جميع العباد؛ إذ إن العباد غير معصومين من الزلل والعصيان، ولكن الكارثة التي استشرت عند المسلمين اليوم هي الإصرار على المعاصي وترك باب التوبة دون أوبة، وهناك موانع وعوائق تحول بين العبد وتوبته إلى الله عز وجل، ينبغي على العبد معرفتها ليتجنبها ويكون على حذر منها. التوبة إلى الله تعالى. أقسام التوبة: ثم إن هذه التوبة تنقسم إلى قسمين: توبة نصوح صادقة صاحبها صادق في توبته، صادق في توجهه إلى الله، قاصد بذلك الخروج من الذنب، وهذه هي التوبة المقبولة. وتوبة غير نصوح، فصاحبها عازم على الرجوع ناوٍ للتكرير، إنما يتوب بلسانه وقلبه يكذب ذلك، وهذه التوبة هي زيادة افتراء واقتراف -نسأل الله السلامة والعافية-؛ لأن صاحبها لم يعزم على ترك المنهي عنه أصلاً، وإنما قال بلسانه قولاً لا ينويه بقلبه، وأشهد الله على ما يقول وهو كاذب، فكلامه الذي يقوله يلعنه، واستغفاره الذي يستغفر به يلعنه؛ لأنه يكذبه من باطنه وقلبه. الحالات التي لا تقبل فيها التوبة: ..
body_en:
*[Site synopsis]* Repentance is obligatory upon all God's servants, since the servants are not preserved from slips and disobedience. But the calamity that has spread among the Muslims today is persistence in acts of disobedience and the leaving of the door of repentance without returning through it. There are impediments and obstacles that stand between the servant and his repentance to God, mighty and majestic, which the servant ought to know, so as to avoid them and be on his guard against them.

## Repentance to God Most High. The divisions of repentance

Now this repentance divides into two kinds. There is a sincere, truthful repentance, whose author is truthful in his repentance and truthful in his turning to God, intending by it to come out from the sin; and this is the repentance that is accepted. And there is a repentance that is not sincere, whose author is resolved upon returning to the sin and intends to repeat it; he repents only with his tongue while his heart belies it. This repentance is a further fabrication and a further offence — we ask God for soundness and well-being — because its author has not resolved at all to leave off what is forbidden. He has merely said with his tongue words he does not intend in his heart, and has called God to witness what he says while he is lying. So the speech he utters curses him, and the asking of forgiveness by which he asks forgiveness curses him, because he belies it from within himself and from his heart.

## The states in which repentance is not accepted

flags.note: CRITICAL for display and the sharpest instance of the pattern in this run. The record ends on a section HEADING — 'the states in which repentance is not accepted' — followed by two dots and nothing else. A reader arriving at this page is left at the threshold of a consequential question about whose repentance God does not accept, with no answer, and the omission is invisible unless the page says so. The English reproduces the heading and the ellipsis exactly and supplies not one word. This record must carry a prominent excerpt banner or be suppressed.

translator_notes: One of a run of thirteen records, IDs 688-700, all uploaded on 5 and 8-9 May 2011 within a few hours of one another, all built to the same template and all excerpts. Each carries a site-written synopsis, then a section heading, then the opening formula and first lines of a lesson, and then breaks off; the full text sits behind a .doc download in the /medias/doc/c-a-* series. The uniform timestamps are a bulk upload and say nothing about when the lessons were delivered.

The record contains two distinct voices and the English keeps them apart. The opening paragraph is a synopsis written by the site, about the lesson and in the third person; everything from the section heading onward is the Sheikh's own words as transcribed. Nothing in the synopsis may be quoted as his.
'توبة نصوح' echoes the wording of Sūrat al-Taḥrīm 66:8; the Sheikh does not present it as a quotation and no reference has been added.
The CMS timestamp is an upload date.
